evidence.V1: Ladder-back chair reads from front, three-quarter, top and silhouette (gold-ball posts, top rail, three slats, seat, four legs, stretchers); front outline symmetric (A15 X 0.0).
evidence.V2: Big seat + back frame, medium top rail, legs and stretchers, small slats and gold finials - clear hierarchy.
evidence.V3: Proportions are sensible but stiff: square straight legs and posts, a flat slab seat and evenly spaced slats with no taper, splay, curve or chunky exaggeration beyond the ball finials.
evidence.V4: Consistent soft chamfers on posts, rail, slats and seat edge catch a clean highlight in close_back and close_seat studio shots.
evidence.V5: Close-ups of back, finial and seat are clean: no seams, pinches, z-fighting or stray faceting; finials sit flush on the posts.
evidence.V6: Wood in three values (seat light, frame mid, top rail dark) plus gold finials; painted colourways keep the same structure.
evidence.V7: 884 tris vs medium target 2000: under target.
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material, kit gold accent, chamfer size and smooth shading match the kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, bottom-centre origin, MeshPart white, Seat note.

top_fixes: Give the legs a taper and slight outward splay and the back posts a slight backward rake for a stylised read
Shape the seat (rounded front edge or dished top) and curve the top rail
